turns.question: Who spent more per order in September 2026, our Turkish or our Dutch customers, and what was their average?
turns.answer: Turkish customers spent slightly more per order in September 2026 (1-30 September): an average order value of 109.64 EUR versus 109.45 EUR for Dutch customers, both over non-cancelled orders. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
